messages.subject: secr 4.2.0
parts:
The main change in this version concerns the number of threads used when fitting models. This now defaults to 2 rather than one less than the maximum.  Set the 'ncores' argument of secr.fit() or setNumThreads() for more. The change was needed for compliance with CRAN policy; with the new default a single user is less likely to hog resources on a multi-user system.

A new random systematic design 'lacework' is introduced e.g., make.lacework(). fxi.secr() and related functions are enabled for polygon detector types.
